outcomes.question: Colorado State vs. Texas State: 3Q O/U 10.5

raw_market.question: Colorado State vs. Texas State: 3Q O/U 10.5
raw_market.description:
In the third quarter of the college football game between Colorado State and Texas State, scheduled for October 15 at 8:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Colorado State and Texas State combine to score 11 or more points in the third quarter.

If the combined third quarter total is less than 11, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
